snippet.title: The Last Screening | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Whislist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3632740/The_Last_Screening/

🎥 Welcome to The Last Screening — You find yourself inside a cinema hallway, ready to watch your film. The venue, however, has other plans for you.

The Last Screening is an anomaly horror game that fans of I’m on Observation Duty, MapFriend, and The Exit 8 will absolutely love.

In this unsettling indie horror experience, you’ll find yourself in a haunted cinema whre you need to identify disturbing anomalies before it’s too late. Things get weirder the longer you stay… Can you survive the night shift?

🧠 Spot the difference meets found footage horror. If you enjoy horror movies, liminal spaces, and subtle tension, this is for you.

👁️ WATCH closely… or risk missing something truly terrifying.
